title: Birds
statementMd:
Apart from plush toys, Imp is a huge fan of little yellow birds!

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/945648b7e469955ae638081877d7a509b17dd50e.png)

To summon birds, Imp needs strong magic. There are $*n*$ trees in a row on an alley in a park, there is a nest on each of the trees. In the $*i*$-th nest there are $*c*_{*i*}$ birds; to summon one bird from this nest Imp needs to stay under this tree and it costs him $*cost*_{*i*}$ points of mana. However, for each bird summoned, Imp increases his mana capacity by $*B*$ points. Imp summons birds one by one, he can summon any number from $0$ to $*c*_{*i*}$ birds from the $*i*$-th nest.

Initially Imp stands under the first tree and has $*W*$ points of mana, and his mana capacity equals $*W*$ as well. He can only go forward, and each time he moves from a tree to the next one, he restores $*X*$ points of mana (but it can't exceed his current mana capacity). Moving only forward, what is the maximum number of birds Imp can summon?

## Input

The first line contains four integers $*n*$, $*W*$, $*B*$, $*X*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{3}, 0 ≤ *W*, *B*, *X* ≤ 10^{9}$) — the number of trees, the initial points of mana, the number of points the mana capacity increases after a bird is summoned, and the number of points restored when Imp moves from a tree to the next one.

The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*c*_{1}, *c*_{2}, ..., *c*_{*n*}$ ($0 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{4}$) — where $*c*_{*i*}$ is the number of birds living in the $*i*$-th nest. It is guaranteed that ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/74f3aaeca88b9721fe0f0b8ea082852e882209b2.png).

The third line contains $*n*$ integers $*cost*_{1}, *cost*_{2}, ..., *cost*_{*n*}$ ($0 ≤ *cost*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$), where $*cost*_{*i*}$ is the mana cost to summon a bird from the $*i*$-th nest.

## Output

Print a single integer — the maximum number of birds Imp can summon.

## Note

In the first sample base amount of Imp's mana is equal to $12$ (with maximum capacity also equal to $12$). After he summons two birds from the first nest, he loses $8$ mana points, although his maximum capacity will not increase (since $*B* = 0$). After this step his mana will be $4$ of $12$; during the move you will replenish $4$ mana points, and hence own $8$ mana out of $12$ possible. Now it's optimal to take $4$ birds from the second nest and spend $8$ mana. The final answer will be — $6$.

In the second sample the base amount of mana is equal to $1000$. The right choice will be to simply pick all birds from the last nest. Note that Imp's mana doesn't restore while moving because it's initially full.
statementZhMd:
除了毛绒玩具之外，Imp 还非常喜欢黄色的小鸟！

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/945648b7e469955ae638081877d7a509b17dd50e.png)

为了召唤小鸟，Imp 需要强大的魔法。公园的一条小路旁有一排 $*n*$ 棵树，每棵树上都有一个鸟巢。第 $*i*$ 个鸟巢中有 $*c*_{*i*}$ 只鸟；为了从这个鸟巢召唤一只鸟，Imp 需要待在这棵树下，并消耗 $*cost*_{*i*}$ 点法力值。不过，每召唤一只鸟，Imp 的法力值上限会增加 $*B*$ 点。Imp 逐只召唤鸟，他可以从第 $*i*$ 个鸟巢中召唤 $0$ 到 $*c*_{*i*}$ 只鸟中的任意数量。

初始时，Imp 站在第一棵树下，拥有 $*W*$ 点法力值，且法力值上限同样为 $*W*$。他只能向前移动，并且每次从一棵树移动到下一棵树时，都会恢复 $*X*$ 点法力值（但法力值不能超过当前的法力值上限）。在只能向前移动的情况下，Imp 最多能召唤多少只鸟？

## 输入格式

第一行包含四个整数 $*n*$、$*W*$、$*B*$、$*X*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{3}, 0 ≤ *W*, *B*, *X* ≤ 10^{9}$）——树的数量、初始法力值、召唤一只鸟后法力值上限增加的点数，以及 Imp 从一棵树移动到下一棵树时恢复的法力值点数。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*c*_{1}, *c*_{2}, ..., *c*_{*n*}$（$0 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{4}$）——其中 $*c*_{*i*}$ 表示第 $*i*$ 个鸟巢中鸟的数量。保证 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/74f3aaeca88b9721fe0f0b8ea082852e882209b2.png)。

第三行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*cost*_{1}, *cost*_{2}, ..., *cost*_{*n*}$（$0 ≤ *cost*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$），其中 $*cost*_{*i*}$ 表示从第 $*i*$ 个鸟巢召唤一只鸟所需的法力值。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——Imp 最多能召唤的鸟的数量。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，Imp 的初始法力值为 $12$（法力值上限也为 $12$）。从第一个鸟巢召唤两只鸟后，他损失了 $8$ 点法力值，尽管他的法力值上限不会增加（因为 $*B* = 0$）。此时他的法力值为 $12$ 点中的 $4$ 点；移动过程中会恢复 $4$ 点法力值，因此他拥有 $12$ 点上限中的 $8$ 点法力值。现在，最优选择是从第二个鸟巢中召唤 $4$ 只鸟，并消耗 $8$ 点法力值。最终答案为 $6$。

在第二个样例中，初始法力值为 $1000$。正确的选择是直接从最后一个鸟巢中召唤所有鸟。注意，由于 Imp 初始时法力值已满，因此移动时不会恢复法力值。
